summary_en: Terilogy Holdings authorized buyback of up to 580,000 shares (3.48% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 200 million yen through market purchases from November 20 to December 30, 2026, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 19, 2026, Terilogy Holdings Corporation's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock under the provisions of the Companies Act. The company will repurchase up to 580,000 shares, representing 3.48% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum of 200 million yen. The acquisition will be executed through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 20 and December 30, 2026.

The stated objectives are to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency while enabling flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 459,210 treasury shares against an issued share count of 16,652,532 shares (excluding treasury stock).
